name: Kenilynn S Zanetti
occupation: Owner and manager of Pioneer Rentals (Rocket Miner, Nov. 1, 2024)
education: Western Wyoming Community College and the University of Wyoming (Rocket Miner, Nov. 1, 2024; degree fields not stated in that article)
prior_offices: Wyoming House of Representatives, District 16, 1995–2000 (Rocket Miner, Nov. 1, 2024; also stated as six years in the House in her 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: Kenilynn S. Zanetti of Rock Springs, a Democrat, ran for Senate District 12 in 2024 and lost the general election. In her 2024 WyoFile questionnaire she wrote that she had lived in Wyoming all her life, mostly in Rock Springs, was born in Rock Springs, and would be 78 on Election Day 2024. She wrote that she had served six years in the Wyoming House, including on the Agriculture, Public Lands and Water Resources; Labor, Health and Social Services; Select Water; and Select Finance committees, and that she was one of the original founders of the local YWCA, served on the Sweetwater County Foundation board, and served for many years on the Big Sandy Conservation District board (now the Sweetwater Conservation District).

The Rocket Miner, on Nov. 1, 2024, reported the same House service as House District 16 from 1995 to 2000, described her as a fourth-generation Wyomingite, and said she graduated from Western Wyoming Community College and the University of Wyoming, is the owner and manager of Pioneer Rentals, and has three children and six grandchildren.
